name: opusclip
description: Turn long-form videos into short clips and post them to social platforms via the OpusClip API.

interface.shortDescription: Turn long videos into short clips
interface.longDescription: OpusClip clips long-form videos into vertical shorts using AI, and can publish or schedule them on YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and X. Ships a skill (model knows when to use it) and an MCP server (20 tools wrapping the REST API).
capabilities: Submit YouTube / Vimeo / uploaded videos for AI clipping
List and describe generated clips (transcript, layout, scores)
Publish or schedule clips to social platforms
